description: A manual run on main with max_versions=1 sweeps only the ceiling lane and HEAD, and everything it looks at passes. It did not look at 0.1.1 or 0.1.0, so it may not close an issue that could be about either: the issue is kept, not closed.

summary_contains: Inside the supported range but NOT swept in this run: `0.1.1` and `0.1.0`. max_versions=1 narrowed it
The issue is left exactly as it is, open or not, because max_versions left 0.1.1 and 0.1.0 inside the supported range unswept.
